s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 8 claws and remove the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate LH

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Floor Service Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear floor service hole cover.

s-1.ptxt: Fuel Spill Prevention Procedure

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the fuel pump assembly connector.
Start the engine

s3.ptxt: After the engine stops on its own, turn the ignition OFF.

atten4.ptxt: A fuel malfunction "DTC P0171/25" may be detected.

s3.ptxt: Crank the engine again and check that it does not start.

s2.ptxt: Remove the fuel tank cap and release the pressure in the fuel tank.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Disconnect Fuel Tank Main Tube

s2.ptxt: Spread the tip of the tube joint clip and pull it out in the direction of the arrow.
Pull out the main tube to disconnect it.

item.ptxt: Before work, clean off any mud or other foreign matter on the clip.
The fuel tube joint seals the fuel pump tube and fuel suction plate with an O-ring, so take sufficient care not to damage the connection or allow foreign matter to adhere.
Always perform removal and installation by hand without using tools.
Do not forcibly bend, kink or rotate the nylon tube.
After disconnecting, protect the connecting parts with a plastic bag.
If the nylon tube and fuel suction plate are stuck, push and pull to release them.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Charcoal Canister Outlet Hose NO.1

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the charcoal canister outlet hose No.1 from the fuel suction tube assembly. (*1)

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Fuel Hose

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the fuel hose from the fuel suction tube assembly. (*2)

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Emission Tube NO.1

s2.ptxt: Pinch the retainer by hand as shown in the illustration, and disconnect the fuel emission tube No.1. (*3)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 screws and fuel tank vent tube set plate.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Suction Tube Assembly (with Pump & Gauge)

s2.ptxt: Pull the fuel suction tube assembly out of the fuel tank and disconnect the fuel tube.

atten3.ptxt: Do not bend the arm of the fuel sender gauge.
